successors.name: Dutch East Indies
successors.text: the Matan lands round Sukadana and the Kayong and Kendawangan rivers

capitals.name: Matan (Indra Laya / Sungai Matan, near Ketapang)

ledger.x: 1590: Sukadana becomes the seat of the Tanjungpura kingdom.
1622: Giri Mustaka becomes the first Sultan.
1637: 'The centre of government moved again in 1637 to the Indra Laya region'.
1833: Panembahan Anom is dismissed and the Matan line passes under Dutch influence.

wars.name: Dutch war on Sukadana
wars.outcome: 'The Dutch came to Sukadana in 1604 and fought a war with Queen Sukadana until the queen was replaced.'

wars.name: Mataram expedition against Matan
wars.outcome: 'Adipati Kendal with his Mataram Expedition, attacked Matan (1622)'; the Mataram page has Sultan Agung 'capturing Sukadana, Surabaya's ally in southwest Kalimantan in 1622'.

certainty.note: The page describes the realm by capes (Tanjung Dato to Tanjung Sambar) and rivers, not by a boundary; the outline is Cliopatria's.
